Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <20020119114348...@mb-cl.aol.com>, Peter D Bakija

<pd...@aol.comANTISPAM> writes:
>If I Wake and block someone, and play Obediance, I remain tapped, correct?

Yes. Playing Obedience merely doesn't tap you. ("is not tapped")

It doesn't actively untap you. It leaves you however you were.
